sessionStart.prompt: The claude-desktop plugin is loaded, but it is built for Claude Code and does not work in GitHub Copilot CLI. Its skills drive Claude-only surfaces: the orch-dashboard MCP server addressed as mcp__plugin_claude-desktop_orch-dashboard__*, Claude Code's inline browser pane, and ~/.claude handoff briefs. Do not invoke them here. Tell the user the plugin is Claude-only and point them at the copilot-app plugin for the Copilot App canvases. Nothing else in this hook applies to Copilot.
